limitations: 13families/15affected include two sibling pairs; six represented signatures map eight packets, not eight unrelated cases.

Main text universally low birthweight/exocrine agenesis summary exceeds case-specific evidence: S3 provides unavailable exocrine status for5a/5b/6/7, missing gestational Zscores in6/13b, and sibling5b diabetes at52weeks.
Proband2 iPSC donor deletion also spans ZNF701 in S2; this patient cell model is not a ZNF808-only isogenic lesion. Independent engineered ZNF808 KO provides complementary evidence.

WT/KO RNAseq n3 independent differentiations, patient-iPSC RNAseq n1 and each histone-mark stage n1. Biological convergence supports mechanism but uncertainty not captured by treating genes as independent patient replicates.
Authors explicitly call MER11 enhancer→hepatic induction mechanistic link correlative; targeted editing/3D confirmation remains futurework. No treatment or rescue demonstrated.
